concept: DMS + SCT: heterogeneous DB migration with minimal downtime
tests: Choosing services to migrate Oracle → Aurora PostgreSQL with schema conversion and minimal downtime.
expected: AWS SCT converts schema and code (Oracle → PostgreSQL), AWS DMS moves data with CDC (ongoing replication) for a minimal-downtime cutover. Triggers: "heterogeneous", "Oracle → PostgreSQL", "convert schema", "minimal downtime".
why_not: Snowmobile — physical transfer of exabytes; Kinesis Data Firehose — streaming into S3 etc.; Glue DataBrew — data preparation.
